Chapter 396: Chapter 12 The Ordinary Members of Magic Jade Tower (Please Subscribe)_2

But overall, as long as the World-Breaking Origin Force is sufficient, Lin Yuan can travel to any world, with neither dimensions nor realms able to stop him.

“Tianqing World…”

Thinking of Tianqing World, Lin Yuan planned to receive the information coming from it.

Within his six travels, the one to Tianqing World was definitely the deepest he had mastered, even replacing the world consciousness.

With the Ancestral Demon Tree in charge of the Heavenly Dao, Lin Yuan could barely receive information from Tianqing World through the world coordinate mark of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Hmm?”

...

“So much has happened over these years?”

Lin Yuan focused his mind on the world coordinate mark of Tianqing World.

Suddenly, a massive amount of information from the Ancestral Demon Tree flooded into his mind.

Only a few years had passed in the Main World since the end of his sixth travel.

However, for Tianqing World, due to the difference in the flow of time, thousands of years had elapsed.

During these thousands of years, the beings of Tianqing World had been doing fine, but those several Foreign Evil Gods had repeatedly made proactive approaches, wanting to contact Lin Yuan.

Yet they were all sent away by the Ancestral Demon Tree following Lin Yuan’s instructions.

“Those several Foreign Evil Gods…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes narrowed slightly; he had sensed something off about those Foreign Evil Gods back then. They actually wanted to invite him to explore some Void Secret Realm?

“As long as the Ancestral Demon Tree is seated within the world, there is nothing to fear.”

Lin Yuan was unconcerned.

With the World Tree of the Ancestors having become the ‘Heavenly Dao’ of Tianqing World, it was not to be compared with the original world consciousness, wielding the overwhelming force of the world. Even if ten Foreign Evil Gods attacked, the Ancestral Demon Tree would be able to withstand them.

…

Time passed on.

Another year went by.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged at the top of a mountain, observing the body beneath the vault of the sky.

[Your understanding is against heaven, observing the mysterious body, you have deduced the 3331st Evolution Path…]

“The 3331st Evolution Path…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened slightly, and he immediately began to analyze this Evolution Path.

“This is called an Evolution Path, and it’s related to time? The combination of time and space? The essence of time-space?”

Lin Yuan was amazed.

The Rule of Time, like the Space Rules and the Law of Life, is one of the pillar rules of the Main World.

However, compared to the Space Rules and the Law of Life, the Rule of Time is much harder to understand; to fully comprehend the entire Rule of Time is something only a Supreme Being can achieve.

The ‘resurrection’ ability of a Supreme Being relies on reversing time-space, which requires complete mastery of the Rule of Time, breaking free from the constraints of the River of Time, flowing against it to resurrect a person from a past time.

Of course, the essential nature of life of the resurrected person must reach a certain level, otherwise, if the life essence is too weak, even a Supreme Being flowing against the current cannot ‘fish it out’ to place it on the current timeline.

“The Rule of Time…”

Lin Yuan contemplated closely; time is intangible and ubiquitous, yet incredibly difficult to understand, especially since Lin Yuan was only at the Seventh Rank.

The level was too low; even with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, the benefits were minimal.

“Forget it.”

“I’ll contemplate it after reaching the Eighth Layer.”

“Now, I’ll concentrate fully on understanding the Space Rules.”

“Only with a deep enough understanding of the Space Rules can I better understand the Rule of Time.”

Lin Yuan gave up on the contemplation of the Rule of Time, as it was too unprofitable for him.

…

Time slowly drifted on.

More and more human evolution geniuses entered the Virtual World to understand that body.

These Evo lver geniuses, being latecomers, knew the outcomes of the first Evolvers who contemplated that body.

But not a single Evolver gave up, since being known as an evolution genius, they all were extremely confident, believing that what others couldn’t do, they definitely could.

“I am of the Ethereal Body, and even the Goddess of Wisdom has taken notice of me, hiding and protecting my information. I will definitely deduce the Supreme Evolution Path…”

In one Virtual World, a youngster sat on top of a mountain, looking up at the body beneath the firmament.

Several months later.

“Who am I?”

“Where am I?”

“What should I be doing right now?”

This youngster looked bewildered as his body exploded with a bang.

…

“This is the Supreme Evolution Path, and I have reached the pinnacle of the Eighth Layer, barely having any hope of stepping into the Ninth Rank, not even possibly achieving invincibility at the Eighth Layer.”

“Rather than that, I might as well take the risk, abandon everything, and contemplate that body. If successful, I will receive the nurturing of the entire human civilization.”

An ancient-looking old man made a decision in his heart.

He then applied to the Goddess of Wisdom for a chance to contemplate that body.

A year later.

The ancient-looking old man sat at the top of a mountain.

Looking at the body under the expanse of the sky, his expression was extremely solemn.

“Something’s not right.”

“This body is not right.”

“The Evolution Path I cultivate is not right.”

This ancient-looking old man kept recalling something, feeling that a chunk of his memory was beginning to be missing.

And this sign even had a tendency to spread.

“This body is too demoniac; why would a Supreme Being release such an uncontrollable thing?”

The ancient-looking old man steadied his spirit and decided to give up contemplating.

If he continued to contemplate and practice, he felt that all his memories would be wiped clean.

At that moment, would he become a puppet without any memories?

…

“This body I now have is a special life form that was recently seized. Its talent is far superior to humans, and with it to understand that body, the process should be more effective.”

A green-skinned man with dragon horns on his forehead smiled.
